question: Should Neuralwatt ship with subscription kWh as the primary quota and prepaid USD as a separate pay-as-you-go balance, using this PR rather than https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/1760 as the canonical landing branch?
rationale: Both branches are viable and contain shared implementation history, while the current branch expands the visible quota contract beyond the earlier balance-focused version; selecting the permanent presentation and canonical branch requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: Accept the two-pool quota presentation, obtain exact-head runtime proof, and close the older overlapping PR after preserving its authorship and evidence links.

options.title: Continue the older PR
options.body: Port any required subscription-presentation and current-main integration changes into the older PR, then close this duplicate landing branch.

recommendation.title: Use this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Accept the two-pool quota presentation, obtain exact-head runtime proof, and close the older overlapping PR after preserving its authorship and evidence links.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the provider hardening and both current-main integration merges and are best positioned to choose the permanent product contract.
